notes:
TCC Website 0.14.1: lighter on the server

The owner asked whether the plugin slows the website for visitors or in
the admin. Measured on staging it does not do much (its own screens open
about as fast as the Dashboard), and these small changes make it lighter.

For visitors
- The lists of upcoming events (the Events menu on every page, the home
  page, /events/ and the ministry pages) are remembered until the first
  event on them is over, at most 6 hours, instead of 10 minutes. They
  still refresh straight away when an event is saved or trashed, and now
  also when an event's categories change in Planning Center.
- The Planning Center screens are loaded only in the admin, not for every
  page a visitor opens.
- An event card without a graphic of its own finds its default graphic
  without asking the database again.

In the admin
- The help and the AI prompts are loaded only on the TCC Website screens,
  not on the Dashboard, the lists of pages and events, or the editor's
  background check-ins.
- The "Waiting for approval" tab loads hand-made events in one go.

Nothing visitors see changes, and no settings or content change.

Tested: 171 tests pass in WordPress Playground.
